If all the letters of the above series are written in the reverse order then which letter will be the 4th from left to the 8th from the right end?
questions.explanation:
A L O W N Z F R C P W O E N V I U L B Q O D N H X Q O V E U

After reversing the series,

U E V O Q X H N D O Q B L U I V N E O W P C R F Z N W O L A

Now

8th letter from the right end is: “R”

Further,

4th from this “R” is “O”.

There are nine persons - I, J, K, L, M, N, O, P, and Q seated in a row facing the north not necessarily in the same order.

L is seated fourth from one of the extreme ends of the row. Q is seated second to the of L. Neither K nor Q is an immediate neighbor of I. O and P are the immediate neighbors of each other. N is seated fourth to the left of O.

 

Who among the following is seated third to the right of Q?
questions.explanation:
• K is seated at one of the extreme ends of the row

  • I is seated third to the left of the one who is seated fourth to the left of K

  • M is seated at one of the extreme ends and second to the left of N

  • L is seated fourth from one of the extreme ends of the row

  • Q is seated second to the of L

  • Neither K nor Q is an immediate neighbor of I

  • N is seated fourth to the left of O

  • O and P are the immediate neighbors of each other

In the question below some statements are given followed by two conclusions I and II. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusions definitely follows from the given statements, disregarding commonly known facts.

 

 

Statements:

Some 1st are 2nd

Some 2nd are 3rd

All 3rd are 4th

Conclusions:

I.    Some 4th are not 1st

II.     All 4th are 1st
questions.explanation:
Following figure can be formed-

Conclusions:

I.       Some 4th are not 1st

II.     All 4th are 1st

We can easily see in the figure that there is no relation between 4th and 1st but there is a possibility between them.

If the given conclusion one is a positive and other is the negative statement. It become the case of either-or.

From the figure, either conclusion I or II follows.

Hence, option d is the correct answer

questions.question:
In each of the questions below are given some statements followed by some conclusions. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the given statements disregarding commonly known facts.


Statements:

Only a few sea are wish.

Some wish are solo.

All solo are dance.

Conclusions:

I. Some sea are dance

II. No sea are dance
options: If either conclusion I or II follows.
If neither conclusion I nor II follows.
questions.explanation:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :-

 

I. Some seas are dance.

This conclusion is not supported by the statements.So,conclusion II is not definitively true based on the given statements.
II. No seas are dance.

This conclusion is contradicted by the statements. Conclusion I establishes that some seas are dance, so the statement "No seas are dance" is not true. Therefore, conclusion II does not follow.
but Both elements are same and making a complimentary pair.

Hence, the correct answer is "either conclusion I or II follows."

questions.question:
In each of the questions below are given some statements followed by two conclusions. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the given statements disregarding commonly known facts.

 

Statements:

All men is women

Some child is women

No men is boy

Conclusions:

I. Some men is child

II. No men is child
options: If either conclusion I or II follow
If neither conclusion I nor II follow
If both Conclusion I and II follow
questions.explanation:
Conclusion I: Some men is child is not true because there is no direct relationship visible in the diagram.

Conclusion II: No men is child is not true as there is no negative relationship between men and child.

Either I or II follows.

Study the following information carefully and answer accordingly.

 

Seven events A, B, C, D, E, F and G are held on different days of same week from Monday to Sunday but not necessarily in the same order. Events, which start with a vowel, are held in India.
G is held two days after D. C is held before D but not immediately before D. F is held immediately before B. D is held on neither Tuesday nor Friday. Events held in India are not held on Sunday. E is held after A.

 

E is held on which day?
questions.explanation:
Starting Point: First try to place G and D to have least number of cases.

Clues:

1. G is held two days after D.

2. D is held on neither Tuesday nor Friday.

Inference:

From clue 1 and clue 2, G is held on Wednesday or Friday or Saturday.

Clues:

3. C is held before D but not immediately before D.

4. F is held immediately before B.

Inference:

From clue 3, case I is rejected as C can’t be placed. And thus, C is held on Monday or Tuesday.

From clue 4, F is held on Tuesday or Saturday.

Clues:

5. Events held in India are not held on Sunday.

6. E is held after A.

Inference:

From clue 5, case III is rejected as A and E can’t be placed.

From clue 6, A is held on Tuesday, E is held on Thursday.

The final table is given below:

E is held on Thursday.

questions.question: A leak in the bottom of a tank can empty the full tank in 12 hours. An inlet pipe fills water at the rate of 8 liters a minute. When the tank is full, the inlet is opened and due to the leak the tank is empty in 16 hours. Find the capacity of the tank.
questions.explanation:
Given,

Leak can empty tank in 12 hours

So, quantity emptied in 1 hour = \(\frac{1}{12}\)

Resultant emptied the tank in 16 hours

So, quantity emptied in 1 hour = \(\frac{1}{16}\)

So, \(\frac{1}{12}\) - \(\frac{1}{16}\) = \(\frac{1}{48}\) for 1 hour

So, For 1 minute = \(\frac{1}{48 \times 60}\) = \(\frac{1}{2880}\)

And, inlet is filling at the rate = 8 liters per minute

Hence, Capacity of tank = 2880 \(\times\) 8 = 23040 liters

Alternate Method:

Leak can empty the tank in 12 hours.
Inlet pipe fills water at 8 litres per minute.
When both (leak + inlet) are open, the tank gets empty in 16 hours.
We will find the capacity of the tank.
Convert hours to minutes
1 hour = 60 minutes
So,
12 hours = 720 minutes
16 hours = 960 minutes
Let the tank capacity = x litres
Leak’s rate = x / 720 litres per minute (emptying, so –x/720)
Inlet’s rate = +8 litres per minute
When both are open, tank becomes empty in 960 minutes
So net rate = − x / 960 litres per minute
Equation
Inlet + Leak = Net rate
8 − x/720 = −x/960
Simplify
8 = x/720 − x/960
Take LCM of 720 and 960 → 2880
x(4 − 3)/2880 = x / 2880
So,
8 = x / 2880
Solve for x
x = 8 × 2880 = 23040 litres
Final Answer:
The capacity of the tank = 23,040 litres.

questions.question: A bag contains Rs. 300 in the form of rupees. 1 rupee, 50  paise and 10 paise coins in the ratio 1 : 2 : 10. The  number of 10 paise coins is?
questions.explanation:
Let, Number of 1 Rupee coins = x

Number of 50  paise coins  = 2x

Number of 10  paise coins = 10x

And,

Value of all 1 rupee coins = 1(x) = Rs.x

Value of all  50  paise coins = 0.5(2x) = Rs.x

Value of all  10  paise coins = 0.1(10x) = Rs.x

Now

Rs. 300 = Rs. (x + x + x) (given)

 300 = 3x

 x = 100

Hence, number of 10 paise coins = 10x = 10(100) = 1000

questions.question: A train 175 m long passes a person, running at 4 km/hr in the same direction in which the train is going in 20 seconds. Calculate the speed of the train.
questions.explanation:
Given Information:
• Length of the train is 175 meters.
• Speed of the person is 4 km per hour.
• The person and the train are moving in the same direction.
• Time taken to pass the person completely is 20 seconds.

Calculation:
When a train passes a person, the distance covered is equal to the length of the train.

Distance = 175 meters.

Time = 20 seconds.

So, relative speed = Distance / Time
Relative speed = 175 / 20
Relative speed = 8.75 m per second.

This is the speed of the train relative to the person.
Since both are moving in the same direction, relative speed is equal to the speed of the train minus the speed of the person.

Speed of the person = 4 km per hour
Convert into m per second.

4 × 5 / 18 = 10 / 9 m per second.

Let the speed of the train be x m per second.

Then, x − 10 / 9 = 8.75

8.75 = 35 / 4

So, x − 10 / 9 = 35 / 4

x = 35 / 4 + 10 / 9

Take LCM of 4 and 9 which is 36.

x = (35 × 9 + 10 × 4) / 36
x = (315 + 40) / 36
x = 355 / 36 m per second.

Now convert into km per hour.

Speed in km per hour = 355 / 36 × 18 / 5
Speed in km per hour = 355 / 10
Speed in km per hour = 35.5 km per hour.

So, the speed of the train is 35.5 km per hour.
Hence, option B is correct.

Used Concepts:
• When a train passes a person, the distance covered is equal to the length of the train.
• Relative speed in the same direction is found by subtracting speeds.
• Conversion of km per hour to m per second using multiplication by 5 / 18.
• Conversion of m per second to km per hour using multiplication by 18 / 5.
• Speed = Distance / Time.

Therefore, S.P. = 75% of Rs. 1500

\(\Rightarrow SP = \frac{75}{100} \times 1500\)

\(\Rightarrow SP = 75 \times 15\)

\(\Rightarrow SP = 1125\)

questions.question: A reduction of 40% in the price of rice enables a housewife to buy 10 kg more for Rs.2400. The reduction price per Kg of rice is.?
questions.explanation:
Let the original price be Rs. x

So, the quantity of rice purchased at the cost of Rs. x is 2400x kg

Now, 40% reduction in price = 60% of original price

= 0.6 × 2400 = 1440

So, now 2400x Kilo rice can be bought for Rs 1440. Hence, the new cost per kg = 1440(2400÷ x)=3x5

New quantity of rice = 2400x + 10

So, according to the question, 3x5×(2400x + 10) = 2400

Therefore, X = 160, so, new price = 3x5 = 3×1605 = 96

Therefore the price per kg has decreased = 160 – 96 = 64

questions.question: Aman, Beena and Chetan start running around a circular field having circumference 180 metre at the same time from the same point. questions.explanation:
Given:

Time taken by Aman to complete one round of the circular field,

\(= \frac{180}{2} = 90\ minutues\)

Time taken by Beena to complete one round of the circular field,

\(= \frac{180}{2.5} = 72\ minutues\)

Time taken by Chetan to complete one round of the circular field,

\(= \frac{180}{3} = 60\ minutues\)

L.C.M of 90, 72, 60=360 minutes=\(\frac{360}{60} = 6\ hours\)

questions.question:
If the radius of a sphere is 28 m, then find the volume of the sphere.

[Take \(\pi = 3\)]
questions.explanation:
Volume of sphere \(= (\frac{4}{3}){\pi r}^{3}\)

\(= (\frac{4}{3}) \times (3) \times 28 \times 28 \times 28 = 87808\ m^{3}\)

questions.question: A 40 litre mixture of soda and water contains soda and water in the ratio 3 : 2. 20 litres of the mixture is removed and replaced with pure soda. This process is done one more time. What is the ratio of soda to water now?
questions.explanation:
As, quantity of mixture = 40 L

So, quantity of soda = 24L

And, quantity of water = 40 – 24 = 16L

Now, 20 L of mixture is drawn out, 12L of soda & 8L of water is drawn out. And same quantity is left

Then, 20L of soda is added, so mixture will have (12+20) 32L soda & 8L water

Again, 20L of mixture is drawn out, 16L of soda & 4 L of water will be drawn out, and same amount would be left.

Now, we again add 20L soda, so mixture will have (16+20) 36L soda & 4L water

Hence, required ratio = 36:4 = 9:1

questions.explanation:
The ratio of the number of days taken by A and B = 1:2

Time taken by B to complete the work alone = 2 × 25 = 50 days.

The ratio of efficiency of B and C = 100: 80 =5: 4.

The ratio of time taken by B and C = 4: 5.

Time taken by C to complete the workdays=504×5=62.5

questions.question: A boat has to cover 13 km in downstream direction and speed of the boat in still water is 14 km/h. After traveling for 30 minutes, the speed of the stream is decreased to 4 km/h and the remaining distance is covered in 10 minutes. Find the initial speed of the stream.
questions.explanation:
Let the initial speed of the stream = ‘x’ km/h

From the question:

\(\frac{(14\  + \ x)\  \times \ 30}{60}\  + \ \frac{(14\  + \ 4)\  \times \ 10}{60}\  = \ 13\)

14 + x = 20

x = 6

So, the initial speed of the stream = 6 km/h
